Messages.Author: Brian Reed
Messages.Body:
Quick question:
If a player recruits Charnas the Imp and places the imp on another vampire,
what happens if a different player plays Far Mastery, or an equivalent to
gain control of Charnas? Does that player get to decide which minion
acquires Charnas, or is Charnas placed on the minion that played Far
Mastery?

-Brian

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Card text from Far Mastery: "The acting vampire takes control of a
retainer controlled by another vampire." So Charnas is placed on
the acting vampire.
